title: S4 project directives: duplicate propulsion, disable craft at a distance

tellings.quote: directive was duplicate the propulsion system at any cost is directive one and directive two was be able to disable the system at a distance at any cost.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at a secret Nevada site called S-4 in 1988 and 1989, says the project there had two orders. According to Lazar, the first was to copy the craft's propulsion system at any cost, and the second was to find a way to switch that system off from a distance at any cost. If true, it would mean the government was trying to both copy and defend against craft it did not build.
